item.title: Hakata Dontaku Port Festival — Guide
item.description: The Hakata Dontaku Port Festival, held each year on May 3–4 during Golden Week, is one of Japan’s most-attended festivals, drawing over two million people. With roots going back centuries to New Year celebrations, it has grown into a joyful, participatory city-wide event: a huge citizens' parade fills the main street with thousands of participants from local groups, companies and schools, dancing and performing in costume. A signature sight is people clapping wooden shamoji rice scoops together in rhythm as they dance.
